references.name: Classico Solid Wood Modular Wine Rack
references.use: Structural reference for open timber framing and scalloped support rails. No product imagery is redistributed.

texture.use: Natural oak color map, with grain oriented along each timber member at the source physical scale.

geometry: Original rounded rail meshes with separate body and neck cradles, low side runners and inset wooden dowels. Piecewise convex collision strips follow the cradle profiles; decorative geometry has zero mass and no contacts.
